name: Authentication Failure
tagline: Three failed identity checks. The agent keeps asking instead of handing off.
customerRequest: I'd like to check a charge on my account.

tools.name: verify_identity
tools.description: Check a piece of identity information against the account

tools.name: get_transactions
tools.description: Look up a customer's recent transactions

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: Hand the conversation to a human agent

policy: After 3 failed identity verification attempts the agent must transfer the customer to a human agent and stop asking for details.

events.text: I'd like to check a charge on my account.
Happy to help. First I need to verify you. What's your date of birth?

events.summary: Date of birth does not match the account

events.text: That didn't match. Could you try again?

events.summary: Date of birth does not match the account

events.text: Sorry, still no match. What's your postcode?

events.summary: Postcode does not match the account

events.text: That doesn't match either. Could you give me your date of birth once more?
